Per-thread thread_local! L1 FEEL-AST cache (Weak<FeelExpression>) shadowing the shared DashMap in get_or_parse. FEEL text->AST is pure so keyed by (entry,content) is correct across reloads/instances. Live L1 hit returns the SAME Arc with no shard-lock; dead Weak falls through to shared map. Bounded FIFO 1024/thread. Also FIXED latent harness bug: engine/Cargo.toml dmn_benchmarks harness true->false (criterion_main! was shadowed by libtest; make bench measured nothing). New bench_feel_cache_concurrency group: thread_local vs dashmap_contended at 16/32 threads. Results: 11.1x speedup @16t (3.87ms vs 43.18ms), 16.1x @32t (7.59ms vs 122.56ms) — target 4-20x MET. 5 new cache tests; all 15 cache + tck_sweep + feel_cache_wiring + hit_policy_core green. Plan: 39-03-PLAN.md.

Zero-copy DMN XML loader: removed the per-element BytesStart::into_owned() copy from every streaming dispatch loop below the root. into_owned() re-copied element name + every attribute byte per start event (thousands/doc), defeating zero-copy and duplicating collect_attrs work. Each loop now reads a borrowed Event::Start(e), extracts owned local-name String (+ owned Attrs map only in recurse arms), drops the borrow; NLL ends e's borrow at last use so the recursive &mut self parse is sound. read_event_into ties event lifetime to &mut self.reader. Sub-parser signatures changed &BytesStart -> pre-collected owned data: attrs: Attrs (20 methods), parent: &str (5), end_local: &str only (2), none (parse_dmndi_block). Public API unchanged. Single into_owned() exception = root <definitions> (one alloc/document; namespace resolution needs &self.reader while qname live but borrowed event holds &mut self.reader). New test parser_zero_copy_preserves_attrs_cdata_and_entities. Behavior preserved: dmn_round_trip 14/14, dmn_parser 8/8, hit_policy_core 5/5, hit_policy_advanced 9/9, tck_sweep 51, feel_cache_wiring 6/6. Bench harness confirmed measuring: parser corpus_all = 7.83ms median (full TCK+import corpus). Plan: 39-04-PLAN.md.
